app.name: Night Heist
app.long_description:
Night Heist is a first-person stealth heist game for the Wii.
Phase 0 toolchain build: a lit, textured test scene with a pointer-aimed torch and a live readout of Wii Remote pointer and Nunchuk input.
Controls: pointer aims the torch, Nunchuk stick moves, Z crouch, tilt Nunchuk to lean, B torch on/off, A click + rumble, 1/2 change stress-test load, C spin speed, + pause, HOME exit.
